title: Phil takes the crew fares
qa: Cash begins partly inside the open tan envelope. Phil’s right glove lifts the same bundle completely clear at about 1.75 seconds and draws it into his coat by 3.75 seconds. The empty envelope settles on the green ledger. The white envelope label is blank in the hosted starting image and the clip. The 14 mm POV stays near its original framing with slight natural drift.
